acceptance: Bundles in results-data and published corpora are checked for generator platform (macOS TPC-H, Windows TPC-DS) and date
Affected bundles are regenerated, labelled or withdrawn; cached datasets keyed by the old binaries are invalidated
description: Two generator defects fixed this cycle produced wrong data: TPC-H data generated with the packaged darwin-arm64 or darwin-x86_64 dbgen before #2622 has non-canonical supplier and customer addresses (affects Q2, Q10, Q15, Q20 values), and TPC-DS data generated on Windows before #2623 was generated at scale factor 1 regardless of the requested scale, with trailing separators. Any published result bundle, cached dataset or reference artifact built that way is wrong.
